data.one_liner: Provides Microsoft Fluent UI System icons as Flutter IconData.
data.what_it_does: Exports a large collection of Fluent UI System icons from Microsoft as IconData constants. You can use them directly in Icon or IconButton widgets. The package bundles the font files needed for the icons.
use_when: You need Microsoft‑styled icons in a Flutter app
You want a ready‑made icon set without writing custom SVG handling
avoid_when: You require a custom icon set or need to minimize app size
You need runtime icon generation or theming beyond what the font provides
strengths: Extensive set of official Microsoft icons
Simple API – just import and use IconData
No additional setup beyond adding the dependency
weaknesses: Only provides icons – no widgets or theming support
Increases app bundle size with the font files

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another popular icon pack with a wide variety of icons, useful if you prefer Font Awesome style

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a different open‑source icon set with similar easy‑to‑use API
